name: EBL Bf Neustadt and terminal (example)
description: A bigger part of the lab table, surveyed on 9 October 2026: the station Bf Neustadt with its two platforms (and, in the module Waldhof, the next station Waldhof with the RB 30 to Neustadt; in the module S-Bahn, the light rail S 10 from Pirna to Heidenau) and, along the same tracks, a container terminal with a gantry crane over the three loading tracks, a truck lane and a yard block. In front of the table lies the town of Neustadt: the station building, Bahnhofstraße and the bus station, and the Altstadt with the Markt, the Rathaus and St. Marien, its pedestrian zones (Marktstraße, Lange Straße, the Markt) lined with houses with shops on the ground floor, Gründerzeit blocks round it, the Stadtpark and the Wall; in the east a garden town of single-family houses. Behind the curve lies the high-rise estate Am Plattenring: slabs of 6 and 11 floors, point towers, the Passage with shops, a school, Kitas, the Kaufhalle. Two tram lines run from Lindenstraße along Ringstraße and Bahnhofstraße, line 1 to Neustadt Bf and the Busbahnhof, line 2 through the pedestrian zone Marktstraße to the Markt and round St. Marien, in curves of 25 m, and turn in loops at both ends; where people cross the street to a tram, traffic lights hold the cars. Brückenstraße crosses the main line at a level crossing with half barriers, which trams never cross: bus 261 takes the estate from Neustadt Bf over it to its turning circle Am Wendekreis, bus 262 the garden town from the Busbahnhof to its turning circle in Drosselweg, bus 7 goes round Am Bogen. Some streets are dead ends with turning circles or hammers; cars come and go at Lindenhof, Schulstraße and Leipziger Straße; bikes, e-scooters and cars with parking share the streets. The marker map comes from arail-survey (three photos and a video); it is locked.

layers.name: S-Bahn
layers.description: The S-Bahn (the lab's light rail, Stadtbahn) on its strip along the windows, from Pirna to Heidenau: the S 10 runs on track 2 and turns at Heidenau. The strip lies at the level of the table along Bf Neustadt and Heidenau, above the NBS in front of it, and rises to about 55 mm at the Pirna end, here in steps (estimated from the photos); its tracks and platforms are drawn after them.

layers.name: Waldhof
layers.description: Waldhof, the next station towards the north, on the tables along the windows (the photos of Waldhof south and Waldhof are tracked with it), and the RB 30 from Waldhof to Neustadt: its trains leave Waldhof on the second lap of the NBS, which passes behind Bf Neustadt, run once round the hall out of view (via the swing bridge and Adorf) and come back on the first lap into Bf Neustadt, track G2; there they turn and run back to Waldhof. Waldhof's platforms 1 and 2 with its tracks 1, 2, 4 and 5; the tracks of Waldhof south, where several decks overlap, are approximate.

layers.name: Infrastructure
layers.description: The station's infrastructure: the exit signals N1–N3 of the electronic interlocking, the displays on the platforms, the interlocking building and a maintenance base on a table module at the end of Bahnhofstraße. Infrastructure → Disruption tells a maintenance story to click through: signal N2 fails, is repaired and exchanged; track G3 is renewed.

scenarios.name: Track G2 closed
scenarios.description: Track G2 at platform 2 is closed for half an hour, as for a repair: no train stops there, track G3 runs as usual.

layers.name: Operations
layers.description: Normal operations at Bf Neustadt on a weekday morning: the trains of the railway undertaking on S 1, RB 71 and RE 2. Railway undertaking → Operations puts a unit and a driver on each train, Infrastructure → Operations puts each train on a track; Run plays the plan. The plan runs the trains of the platforms while it plays: the module is shown alone.

layers.name: Breakdown
layers.description: A railway undertaking at Bf Neustadt: its depot (Betriebswerk) with the workshop and a spare unit, on a table module behind the table. Railway undertaking → Disruption tells a story to click through: RB 31 to Talsee breaks down at track G3, the spare unit comes in at track G2, the passengers change trains, and the broken unit goes to the workshop. Its story takes over platform 2: the module is shown alone.

layers.name: Journeys
layers.description: A traveller's view of the station. Railway undertaking → Journeys tells Ada's journey to click through: she walks from her flat on Bahnhofstraße to platform 1, her RB 31 to Talsee is late and her connection to Altstadt lost, her app finds a bus from the bus station; her journey in numbers and her rights as a passenger.

layers.name: Terminal
layers.description: The container terminal at the loading tracks G14–G16: container trains, trucks, the gantry crane and the yard. Railway undertaking → Terminal moves the containers.

scenarios.name: Morning shift at the terminal
scenarios.description: KT 52 arrives on loading track 3; trucks collect and deliver; the crane works the trains and the yard.
